_why: These are @hanzo/ui's stable class HANDLES. A ui <Button> renders as `btn btn-<variant> btn-<size>` plus the @hanzo/gui atomic classes that actually paint it, and <Badge> does the same; ui ships no rules for the handles on purpose — they exist so a host can hook a control from CSS. Verified inert rather than assumed: stripping every btn-*/badge-* class off a rendered element leaves its computed background, padding and radius unmoved, and deleting the one `.btn` rule this app used to carry changed the text-decoration of none of its 606 anchors. The store therefore hooks nothing and defines nothing for them.
_upstream: This file should be DELETABLE. @hanzo/gui 8.0.2's css-check ships a DEFAULT_ALLOW that still names the retired handles — hanzo-button, hanzo-button--*, hanzo-badge, hanzo-badge--* — from before the rename to btn/badge (see this repo's commit 'adopt @hanzo/ui 8.0.44 class handles'). The defaults simply have not caught up. When a @hanzo/gui release allows btn/btn-*/badge/badge-* by default, drop this file rather than maintaining a second copy of the same list.
